run_trf002_check: run the trf002 linting rule to validate base_model_prefix assignments in pretrained model classes
check_base_model_prefix: check that base_model_prefix in a pretrained class is a non-empty canonical string without whitespace
review_pretrained_classes: review pretrained model classes for invalid base_model_prefix string literals or values
test_trf002_violations: test the trf002 checker for violations on empty, whitespace-only, or non-string base_model_prefix values
summarize_trf002_rule: summarize the trf002 linting rule that enforces base_model_prefix as a non-empty canonical token string
